verdict.rationale: The public portals offer free search by company name or EUID, register entries, filed documents and register announcements (Registerbekanntmachungen). A founder can therefore see once a filing has been entered and published. There is no evidence of any public status page or tracker for a pending application or case, and lookups are affected by documented overload outages and labelled a non-binding service. Missing for 10: tracking of in-progress filings or applications by reference number, status-stage visibility before registration, reliable availability of the lookup.
